_what: Buylist estimate rules for the card-page 'what we pay' reveal. Estimates are computed in the shopper's browser as a percentage of the LIVE sell price on the page (variant by variant, so conditions and foils inherit automatically). Sell prices reprice daily, so estimates track daily on their own — this file only changes when the store's buy percentages change.
_howToUpdate: Edit this file (repo chaylon-ui/chaywrite, branch claude/shopify-site-improvements-ztgdt8) and push — the worker auto-deploys. Percentages are fractions: 0.40 = 40% of sell price.
disclaimer: Estimate only, based on a percentage of today's sell price. Final offer is confirmed when we check your cards — condition and demand can change it. Prices move daily.
_tiersExample: tiers let the percentage vary by sell price: [{"upTo": 5, "cash": 0.30, "credit": 0.40}, {"upTo": 50, "cash": 0.40, "credit": 0.50}] — first tier whose upTo >= sell price wins; above the last tier the game's base cash/credit apply. minSell: below this sell price the card is bulk-only (not listed).
